exposure: trial of labor after a previous cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: 3071 women with one previous cesarean delivery and no vaginal delivery who underwent a trial of labor from 2001 to 2011 at an institution with a standardized 'active management of labor' protocol
finding: In a cohort of women with one previous cesarean delivery, a standardized active management of labor protocol resulted in a high rate of successful VBAC (72.5%) with rare serious complications.
mod_finding: Among women with one previous cesarean delivery, 72.5% had a successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
